name: Rocker power switch (SPST, KCD1-style)
description: Main power switch: cuts the supply to the whole build.
notes: Ratings printed on small rocker switches are usually AC (e.g. 6 A 250 V AC). DC breaking capacity is lower, especially for motor loads: derate to about half for 12-24 V DC.
Panel cut-out for KCD1 style: about 21 x 15 mm.
Switch the + line, after the fuse.

keepout.note: panel cut-out 21 x 15 mm, body depth about 20 mm
